source.text: Maxan Thompson Connector FSR 7735-26 (September 8 - 14, 2026): Please be advised that BCTS Babine will be closing the Maxan Thompson Connector FSR at 17 km for mandatory bridge repairs. The closure will be in effect from September 8, 2026 at 0700 hrs through to September 14, 2026, 1600 hrs. The road may reopen earlier depending on how quickly the repairs can be completed. The bridge can be accessed on both sides via public roads/FSRs and both routes are well maintained.
